headline: Executive order makes changes to two earlier orders that set up White House advisory councils.
what_it_does: This order changes two earlier executive orders, 12131 and 13539. Those orders created presidential advisory groups: the President's Export Council, which advises on trade and exports, and the President's Council of Advisors on Science and Technology. The title alone does not say what the specific changes are.

who_it_affects.group: Members of the affected presidential advisory councils
who_it_affects.how: The rules for how these councils are set up or run may change, but the details are not given in the available information.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed December 19, 2011; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
